experiment.title: Fix SIGINT exit code mapping in relay.js
experiment.hypothesis: The relay exits with 143 because the signal logic uses a hardcoded offset (128+15=143) instead of the correct dynamic calculation (128+signalNumber).
experiment.falsifier: If the probe passes after this edit, it confirms the exit code was incorrectly calculated. If it fails, the tool environment cannot execute the proposed change.
experiment.intendedBenefit: Preserves the contract that relay.js exits with the child's actual status (130 for SIGINT), enabling correct error reporting in agent tasks.
